news.title: Sweden Agrees to Join the Eurosystem’s T2 Settlement System
news.body: The European Central Bank and Sveriges Riksbank have agreed that Sweden will join T2, the Eurosystem’s real-time gross settlement system, Finextra reported on November 27. The agreement sets up a settlement-platform migration for participating banks, with testing, implementation milestones and changes to payment-processing procedures forming the practical work ahead.

news.title: MoonPay and Highnote Apply for National Trust Bank Charters
news.body: MoonPay and Highnote have filed applications for national trust bank charters, according to Finextra’s November 27 report. Applications do not confer banking authority: any approval and its conditions would determine the activities each company could undertake. The distinction matters for customers and partners assessing which services the companies could provide under a charter.

news.title: TrueLayer and Papa Johns Pilot AI-Initiated Pay-by-Bank Purchases
news.body: A pilot involving TrueLayer and Papa Johns combines purchases initiated by AI shopping agents with pay-by-bank payments. PYMNTS’ November 27 report describes mandate controls and authorization through the customer’s banking app. These controls connect an agent’s purchase request to customer permission; the pilot does not establish broad production availability across banks.

news.title: Lloyds Restores App and Online Banking After Outage
news.body: Lloyds restored its app and online banking services after an outage, according to Bloomberg reporting cited by PYMNTS on November 27. Restoring those channels reopens customers’ digital access to their accounts. For the bank’s service teams, the follow-through includes resolving customer complaints and establishing whether the interruption affected payment initiation as well as account access.

news.title: Intermex Sues to Enforce Western Union’s $500 Million Merger Agreement
news.body: Intermex sued Western Union to enforce their $500 million merger agreement after Western Union withdrew, Finextra reported on November 27. Intermex seeks enforcement of the transaction, not recognition of a completed combination. Banks and remittance partners therefore cannot base contracts or network arrangements on the two businesses having merged.

perspective: TrueLayer’s payment pilot and MoonPay’s charter application show fintechs pursuing bank-authorized purchases and direct regulatory permissions through distinct routes.

curiosity.text: The Luhn checksum used on many payment-card numbers detects every single-digit error, but not every adjacent-digit swap: it cannot distinguish 09 from 90. Passing the check does not establish that an account exists or that a payment is authorized. Source: Luhn algorithm — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luhn_algorithm
